S. Ahn, C. Cooper, G. Cornuéjols, A. Frieze (1988). Probabilistic analysis of a relaxation for the k-median problem. Mathematics of Operations Research 13(1), 1-31.
F. Barahona, F. A. Chudak (2005). Near-optimal solutions to large scale facility location problems. Discrete Optimization 2(1), 35-50.

description: UflLib's k-median package: six instances of 500 to 3,000 points translated from k-median benchmarks, each point a facility and a city, connection costs Euclidean distances and every opening cost the same, with optimal or best found solutions at three opening cost scales.
name: UflLib k-median

properties.referenceValues: the .opt (optimal) or .bub (best found) files beside each instance, one for each opening cost scale (-10, -100, -1000), whose last number is the solution's cost; the files at scales 100 and 1000 are for instances the package's changefile.c derives by dividing the opening costs

recipe.reason: Its instances hold 22,750,000 facility-customer edges in all, and a graph/v1 result is held whole: the largest such set read and round-tripped whole has 13,125,000 edges (ufllib-koerkel-ghosh-symmetric), and reading the 22,750,000 of ufllib-k-median whole ran out of the default Node heap. It becomes fetchable when graph/v1 results can be streamed (https://github.com/Mearman/keepset/issues/305).
